name: Santi Ricardo Esteban-Delgado
crime: Convicted: GAINESVILLE, Ga. – Three illegal aliens from Colombia who were previously convicted for burglarizing the homes of Asian and Indian families in Forsyth County have been sentenced to federal prison for offenses stemming from their illegal presence in the United States.
